title: The Whale
description: A third character: a whale with 150 HP that moves slowly and starts with Belly Flop, a slam that knocks back every bear around it.

title: Boss Jackpot
description: A boss kill pays triple score, shows the payout in big gold numbers over the body and rains gold candles.

title: Stop Loss
description: A new passive: when you drop under 25% HP, a stop-loss fires once a minute and blasts every bear near you away.
